own: Yes, if an account is just on hold because they had a lack of security and tried to do a change which caused a 24-hour account hold. So basically just really means 24-hour time period for which they can't do any other major changes to the account. They can stay logged in and they could wait out the whole time if they wanted to and when the session runs out they can extend it if they want to. There's just not a lot they can do while they're in the account until the 24-hour hold is up. But of course when they initiate the hold it will strongly recommend that they increase their security to prevent these things from happening again.
question: Can an account in a 24-hour hold still extend its session?
